description: Save a COMP as a git-diffable externalized .tox tree using TouchDesigner's 'save external' (COMP.saveExternalTox). Instead of one opaque binary, the component — and, with recurse=true, every descendant COMP — is written to its own .tox file on disk with its externaltox parameter pointed at that file, so a version-controlled project shows per-node diffs. Writes files under out_dir (destructive) and mutates the live COMP's externaltox pars. out_dir is passed to the TouchDesigner process, so it must be a path that process can write to.

comp_path.description: Full path of the COMP to externalize (its .tox is written to out_dir/<name>.tox).

name.description: Root .tox stem. Defaults to the last path segment of comp_path.

out_dir.description: Local folder to write the externalized .tox tree into. Passed to TouchDesigner as the save target, so it must be reachable from the TD process's filesystem.

recurse.description: When true, externalize every descendant COMP too (each becomes its own .tox file), so the whole subtree is git-diffable. When false, only the root COMP is externalized.

name: export_externalized_tree

comp.description: Echoed COMP path that was externalized.

externalized.description: Each COMP that now points at an external .tox file (node path → externaltox path).

recurse.description: Whether descendant COMPs were externalized too.

root_tox.description: Absolute path of the root externalized .tox.

title: Export externalized .tox tree (git-diffable)
